settings.title: Three ways we
settings.intro: A healthy arts scene needs money, space, and an audience. We work all three at once — so a grant isn't a cheque, it's the start of a season.

features.title: Artist grants
features.text: Open, juried grants for working artists in every discipline — painting, dance, film, sound, and the crafts. No gatekeeping, just a fair panel and a clear brief.

features.title: Venue & space support
features.text: We help independent galleries, theaters, and studios keep their doors open — rent relief, technical grants, and the insurance that lets a small stage take a risk.

features.title: Public programs
features.text: Free exhibitions, open studios, and neighborhood festivals that put art where people already are — the market, the library, the underpass, the schoolyard.

features.title: Youth & education
features.text: Residencies and after-school workshops that put working artists in front of the next generation — because a city's art is only as good as its next idea.

features.title: The Lantern Season
features.text: Our flagship exhibition series, staged across partner venues each autumn. One theme, many rooms, and a citywide opening night that belongs to everyone.

features.title: Advocacy
features.text: We make the case to funders and city hall that the arts are infrastructure — and we publish the numbers that prove the return on every public dollar.

settings.title: What the arts
settings.intro: Artists, venue directors, and neighbors on what the council's support has meant.

reviews.quote: The grant didn't just pay for my materials — it told me the city thought my work mattered. That changed how I showed up in the studio for a year.
reviews.author: Mira O.

reviews.quote: Our rent relief kept the doors open through the quiet months. Without it, the Hollow Stage would have closed and a whole neighborhood would have lost its theater.
reviews.author: D. Reyes

reviews.quote: I took my kids to the riverfront sound installation and they talked about it for weeks. That's what public art should do — meet people where they are.
